purpose: Machine-readable semantic authority for training types, assessment scopes, competency domains, assessment output layers, attribution-candidate classes and instructor-review governance. It is semantic authority, not a field-level persistence schema.

INDIVIDUAL.rule: Individual and platform products remain separable; a team result is not copied to individuals.

TEAM.rule: Team capability is evaluated from shared picture, roles, handoff, communication, synchronization, separation and team objectives; it is not the arithmetic mean of member scores.

PACKAGE.rule: Package assessment covers cross-team objectives, information consistency, task handoff, cross-domain timing and overall mission result.

JOINT_LVC.rule: Joint/LVC extends entity/relation/source/plugin vocabularies while preserving the same C+TPAA-M evidence semantics.

assessment_output_layers.semantics: Q/Q-/U/N_A or governed equivalent; controlled by critical gates and mandatory evidence.
Profile-governed competency diagnostics derived from eligible metric/event evidence.
Traceable events, relations, windows, trajectories, series, media, versions and provenance.

situational_awareness_boundary: P_i proves information availability, not subjective comprehension. Automated SA conclusions require validated observable proxies; higher-level understanding/prediction/judgment may require instructor rubric.

event_responsibility.rule: System/data/external factors are not automatically attributed to an individual.

instructor_review.separation_rule: Automatic results and instructor judgments are stored as separate evidence/assessment products.
instructor_review.override_rule: Instructor override creates a revision and preserves the original automatic result, actor, time, reason and rubric/profile version.
instructor_review.governance: Agreement metrics support rubric calibration/standardization and are not an automatic ranking or punitive score.

rules: Outcome evidence does not replace competency or platform capability.
Missing mandatory evidence invalidates or makes assessment insufficient; it is not silently renormalized.
Individual, team, package and joint/LVC scopes remain explicit throughout API, UI and longitudinal products.
